title: LiCl-driven direct synthesis of mono-protected esters from long-chain dicarboxylic fatty acids
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37209-37215
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04970A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yulong Kuang, Xiaohui Yang, Tianhong Qin, Jigui Wang, Paul Guo, Chaozhe Jiang
A one-step mono-esterification method for long-chain dicarboxylic fatty acids [HO2C(CH2)nCO2H; n ≥ 14] was developed using TFAA (trifluoroacetic anhydride) and LiCl as esterification reagents.
